brief:
A Palestinian journalist was injured Saturday after Israeli forces shot him with rubber-coated metal bullets during a military raid on Deir Abu Mash'al, a village northwest of Ramallah, Middle East Eye reported.

The incident occurred as Israeli troops conducted operations in the area. The journalist's specific injuries and current condition were not immediately detailed in initial reports of the raid.
